# Docker Hub's images that CI pulls, mirrored to GHCR by
# .github/workflows/mirror-images.yml: each line's image (as `docker pull`
# names it on Docker Hub) is copied, every platform, to
# ghcr.io/arugula-salad/ci/<the same name>, e.g. debian:bookworm-slim to
# ghcr.io/arugula-salad/ci/debian:bookworm-slim. The test stack, the
# recipes and the Containerfiles name them as
# ${ARUGULA_IMAGES:-ghcr.io/arugula-salad/ci}/<name> (docs/testing.md,
# "CI's images").

# The test stack (testnet/): its boxes' base.
debian:bookworm-slim
# Not this repo's: arugula-salad/cloud pulls these from the same mirror,
# for its control profile over this test stack (Postgres and the fakes,
# its testnet/compose.yaml) and its platform suite on Postgres.
postgres:17-alpine
node:22-slim
postgres:17
# The desktop app's build image (packaging/desktop/Containerfile):
# desktop-xvfb, app-release's linux jobs.
ubuntu:22.04
# forges-nightly.yml's GitLab (testnet/forges).
gitlab/gitlab-ce:18.4.1-ce.0
gitlab/gitlab-runner:v18.4.0
